# Camp Resource: Toxic Gooler Cooler

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Jan 19, 2025
- 2 min read

Updated: Mar 23, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_0cec1295087948918103dcab349eb9e4~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

Save yourself a trip to a secret lab and get the good stuff right at home!

Generates Toxic Goo.

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Toxic Gooler Cooler__

Image Credit: SugarBombsRADS/Nerevar/vc59755/Reasonable Madness

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_afc4ec8d0dd54e54b59048ed1efad2ad~mv2.jpg)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_17acc7646f004f158a3447811e412e84~mv2.jpg)

**Produces**

Toxic Goo

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

None

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Materials required to craft resource**

3x Glass

1x Nuclear Material

1x Steel

**Holds**

3 Pounds

**Obtainable via**

Season 20 - Glow of the Ghoul - Page 5 - 60 Tickets

Gold Bullion - X - Cautious - X Bullion

**Produces X amount per**

30 minutes

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

2 Flamingo Units
